facts.text: No single open-source or commercial tool has public evidence of validating automatic braking for earth-moving machines across many site types and all-weather sensing.
facts.quote: No single tool, open-source or commercial, has public evidence of validating automatic braking for earth-moving machines across many site types and all-weather sensing.

facts.text: The simulation-tool market is modular: on-road ADAS tool chains have strong sensor and scenario tooling, while heavy-machine physics tools have strong terrain and hydraulics but thin sensor and scenario tooling.
facts.quote: The market is modular: on-road ADAS tool chains with strong sensor and scenario tooling sit beside heavy-machine physics tools with strong terrain and hydraulics but thin sensor and scenario tooling.

facts.text: Open-source tools are viable as a low-license-cost core for an earth-moving-machine automatic-braking validation tool chain, but do not offer the lowest total cost.
facts.quote: Open source is viable for a low-license-cost core but is not the lowest total cost.

facts.text: Public prices for tools used in earth-moving-machine automatic-braking validation are almost entirely absent.
facts.quote: Public prices are almost entirely absent

facts.text: Compute is cheap relative to engineering labor for earth-moving-machine automatic-braking validation.
facts.quote: compute is cheap relative to engineering labor

facts.text: No public study gives team size, timeline or total cost for an off-highway build-versus-buy decision.
facts.quote: no public study gives team size, timeline or total cost for an off-highway build-versus-buy decision.

facts.text: The decisive risk in selecting an earth-moving-machine automatic-braking validation tool chain is credibility, not tool choice.
facts.quote: The decisive risk is credibility, not tool choice

facts.text: For an organization starting from zero in earth-moving-machine automatic-braking validation, the most defensible option is a hybrid: own the scenario catalog, operating-domain definition and correlation data in-house, license or co-develop machine physics, and use a partner for the first correlated sensor model.
facts.quote: a hybrid: own the scenario catalog, operating-domain definition and correlation data in-house, license or co-develop machine physics, and use a partner for the first correlated sensor model (Chapter 11).
